about: The inventory packages/envoy/scripts/check-redact-remote-text.sh and cmd/redact-gate run: each row a requirement of the redaction of remote text, a test, and for a print-site row its function, the name its test captures the production output under, and its mutation. A Go row's package is relative to packages/envoy; a Bun row's file and every mutation's file are relative to the repository root, and a Bun row's test is its full name in Bun's JUnit report.

gate.about: cmd/redact-gate's configuration. base is the ref whose merge base with HEAD is the change's base. rule and printers are the Go functions (types.Func.FullName) and ts_rule the TypeScript declarations (file#name) whose every call the change adds a row's mutation must name; exempt_files are the rule's own definition, which the fixture and control (1) hold; exempt are calls that print nothing.
